text.en:
Section one of Act Numbered Thirty-seven hundred and ninety-nine is amended to read as
"Section 1. Upon the death of any Member of the Legislature of the Philippines during his term of office, his
widow or in default thereof, his legitimate children, or his other legitimate descendants, or legitimate parents,
or other legitimate ascendants dependent upon the support of the deceased Member shall be paid a
compensation equivalent to the total of one yearns salary of such deceased Member, upon presentation of
proof of his death."

This Act shall take effect as of January first, nineteen hundred and forty.
Approved, May 7, 1940.
